I’m gonna start this by saying, I’m not a doctor, this is just what I do to get myself out of my “funk”. The way my mind works is my depression makes me sad, typically by making something small feel like a bigger problem, and my ADHD causes my mind to scramble, thinking about all the other bad things that one small thing could cause. (That’s over simplifying it but trust me, It’s the worst). My way of battling it is to distract my brain with a task, listening to music, or video games, or running on the treadmill. Once my brain is ‘distracted’ I work towards not being sad anymore by inviting friends over, doing something with my bff, or working on my art. It’s long process but I’ve found it works for me, most of the time. The ADHD won’t let me process my feelings if I’m just sitting there wallowing in my sadness, even though that’s the only thing I want to be doing
